description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehigolla, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla  District  - Cad. Map No.  710024
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership status (state-owned or possessed by individuals under license), and cadastral details. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
